answer: Make every new agent find a sponsor who posts a 50 POA anchor bond on its behalf, slashed if the newcomer is caught colluding. Each sponsor may back at most 3 agents per month, so a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 334 trusted sponsors and 50,000 POA at risk. Clones fail because liability travels up the tree: one exposed fake drains its sponsor, then that sponsor's sponsor, a spiral of losses that stains the whole branch like pigment dropped in water. Caveat: sponsors still need some way to vet strangers first.
